title: Closing brown page
slide_intent: Provide a quiet end to the guide so the reader can recognize that the instructional sequence has finished.
strategic_value: The uninterrupted brown field can close the document with a familiar Burger King color while retaining ownership information.
demonstration: A nearly empty brown page contains only a small orange copyright and confidentiality notice at the lower left.
practical_value: Preserve this closing physical page when documenting the full book; it contains no additional design rule.

content_islands.name: Brown closing field
content_islands.spec: Leave the full page brown without a title, logo specimen or application image.

content_islands.name: Ownership footer
content_islands.spec: Retain the small orange copyright and confidentiality notice at the lower left.
